This image is the actual edit target: preserve the same face identity, expression, open brown eyes, skin tone, sculpted brown hair with side ponytail, proportions, front camera, lighting and material fidelity. Change only wardrobe: add a simple white chef coat with restrained molded seam ridges and a compact white chef hat, no badge, buttons with text, apron, tools or props. Keep a single bust with head, neck, shoulders and upper chest, rounded lower edge; no hands or arms or waist. Retain the base's framing and scale relationships; keep the entire hat and bust within comfortable margins on the requested landscape canvas. Premium UC matte-to-satin tactile skeuomorphic finish, no extra hair strands. Solid #f5f5f5 background, 1024x768 landscape PNG. Preserve existing shadows; do not add cast/drop/contact/floor shadows. No scene, logos or text. Return the edited image and explicit local source path.

visual_review.notes: Chef role reads clearly; open eyes, side ponytail and UC face family retained. Oversized hat leaves only a narrow top margin and the bust fills nearly the whole image height. One focused hat-size correction requested. Exact pixel identity is not established.

methodology.generation: One built-in Image Gen call per case, sequential; service-specific prompt shaping logged separately from planner prompt.
methodology.timing: Wall time around tool invocation only; excludes human inspection, narration and tool polling. Export time includes decode, contain, composite and PNG save.
methodology.approval: No user acceptance yet. Visual observations are model review.
methodology.background: No removal or cleanup. Requested #f5f5f5; preserve actual rendered pixels even when the perimeter differs.
methodology.selection: Use planner-selected material/form references, including imperfect legacy material matches. No hidden substitution to improve test outcomes.
